rules.conditions: groceries, utilities, education, fuel, rent, transit, telecom and similar earn the reduced rate; government capped/low

lounge.text: 8 visits a year via Visa Airport Companion; first visit free each year, later ones need USD 1 foreign spend 15 days before else USD 32

valet.text: 2 per month at 18 UAE sites, needs AED 5,000 monthly retail spend

insurance.text: Travel and medical cover up to USD 500,000 for trips up to 90 days

welcome_offer.text: 15,000 Skywards Miles on activation and paying fee; extra 15,000 for balance transfer of AED 30,000 held 6 months

cards.notes: Miles are quoted per USD 1 by the bank; converted to per AED at 3.6725. International (non-AED, non-EEA) spend earns a higher rate that the engine cannot express: 1 mile/USD (0.27/AED) on eligible international spend, 0.5/USD in EEA. Year-one fee is AED 1,575, year two onward AED 735 per DIB's schedule of charges (per aggregator). Government earns miles only on first AED 25,000 per statement; DIB-platform utility/government bill payments earn nothing. Profit rate up to 3.69%/month.. point_value_aed 0.03 is a conservative estimate of a Skywards/Etihad mile. Bank page 2026-11-24: Visa, min salary AED 15,000, fee shown as AED 1,500 (pre-VAT, matches the AED 1,575 year-one figure), miles per USD: Emirates 1.5, foreign up to 1, local up to 0.75, reduced 0.2, EEA 0.5; lounge 8 visits; 2 airport transfers a year needing AED 5,000 monthly spend; welcome 15,000 on activation + 15,000 on AED 30,000 balance transfer.
